whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Barbell Gym,

I noticed your gym has exceptional 4.9★ reviews in the Jagdeo Path & Khajpura locality of Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership and trial inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/barbell

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team The Barbell Gym, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with your 4.9★ rating and strong local presence in Jagdeo Path, Patna, featuring direct WhatsApp trial bookings and mobile-first speed. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
